items.item: There is no greeting or hero; the header has a title and a date-range control
items.evidence: h1 'Tổng quan vận hành kho' next to select#range (Hôm nay / 7 ngày qua / 30 ngày qua) with resolved date '04/11/2026'; no greeting or hero. Extra demo-state selector and Refresh sit on the right.

items.item: Each KPI tile shows label, value and a signed change with its comparison period, without decorative icon tiles
items.evidence: renderKpis: label p, value p.tabular-nums, delta '▲ +23 so với hôm qua' / '+3,6% so với hôm qua' / '-0,17 điểm % so với hôm qua' (range.label supplies the period). Tiles have no icons. Arrows are plain text glyphs.

items.item: Charts use bars for comparison and lines for trends; no pie, donut or gauge; axes have labels and units
items.evidence: renderTrend draws an SVG line chart (current solid, previous dashed) with y label 'Đơn xuất kho (đơn/giờ)', x label 'Giờ trong ngày', ticks and a table toggle. renderZones uses horizontal bars with a 0-100 scale note 'Trục: mức lấp đầy (% sức chứa...)'; the zone bars have no drawn axis, only % labels and a text note. No pie, donut or gauge.

items.item: A needs-attention list links to pre-filtered list pages
items.evidence: Section 'Cần xử lý' (renderAttn): each row is an <a> with href such as /orders?status=late, /inventory?expiry=lt-14d, /receipts?status=discrepancy, /inventory?stock=below-min, /stocktakes?status=recount. It is placed first on mobile and in the right column on xl.

items.item: Numbers use locale formatting and tabular figures
items.evidence: Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN') for counts, percent and signed deltas (shown as '1.268', '99,64%', '-8,8%'); tabular-nums class on KPI values, deltas, table numeric cells and the table time column. Audit: numericCells nonTabular 0, misaligned 0.

items.item: Each widget has loading and empty states
items.evidence: skeleton(id) for all 5 widgets (kpis, attn, trend, zones, dock) with .sk pulse and reduced-motion handling; emptyBox messages per widget in paint() for demo='empty' (e.g. 'Không có đơn xuất kho trong khoảng thời gian này.'); renderAttn and renderDock also have their own empty guards; errorBox with retry. States are reachable via the 'Xem thử trạng thái' selector, and also during every load().

notes: Clean, restrained page: flat white cards with 1px borders, small radii (2-6px), no gradient, glass, emoji, hover-lift or tracked-uppercase labels, and a neutral slate and blue palette rather than a navy sidebar with indigo accent. The LH initials avatar is a real account menu, so not a non-person tell. Status pills use red, amber, blue and slate tints, but each pill carries a text label, so it is not a rainbow-status tell. Minor points: the zone-fill chart has no drawn axis (text note only), the error demo state skips the zones widget, and the right-side demo-state selector is a prototype affordance that is not production UI. Audit score 100 with no violations.
